scope: Post-release local dashboard design and interaction revision; no scientific method or result change.
design_direction: Warm paper background and dotted grid
Blue accents, pixel display type, serif body and monospace labels
Original source-selection illustration and research-specific layout
Self-hosted fonts with upstream SIL Open Font License notices

dom_checks.scope: jsdom DOM behavior checks with explicitly synthetic API fixtures; not a browser layout or real-model test
checks: Initial source cards, JSON and count agree; ready/cold readiness is truthful
Card edits survive a JSON round trip; source removal clamps k
Add/remove sources, stepper and reset preserve a valid example
Invalid JSON blocks submission and keeps JSON editor available
Duplicate IDs, reference fields and missing methods fail before a request
Completion renders actual answers, context text, costs, graph and accessible links
Fallback displays the actual classical method; untrusted answer is text, never markup
Backend validation and terminal failure re-enable controls and report real errors
Arrow-key tab navigation preserves selection and focus

syntax_and_format: Prettier check of HTML/CSS/JS and DOM check script

real_model_comparison.scope: One real-model fictional-source integration check; not a latency benchmark or dataset accuracy result.

deployment.image_build_scope: Service-only overlay on the existing tested locked CPU runtime; not a fresh dependency rebuild. The normal Dockerfile builds current source for a clean installation.
deployment.model_mount: Existing read-only local model-cache mount; no weights bundled.

browser_visual_review.reason: Chrome inventory available, but repeated browser navigation/tab/screenshot calls failed with a browser-control timeout-options error, including after runtime reset.

limits: DOM tests use synthetic API fixtures and do not lay out CSS.
One real-model fictional example verifies integration, not dataset accuracy or latency guarantees.
No prompt-injection resistance or quantum advantage is established.
The frozen research release, manuscript and saved scientific outcomes are unchanged.
upstream_license_formatting: License notices are preserved verbatim, including one upstream trailing space in SourceSerif4-OFL.txt; project whitespace checks exclude the upstream OFL notices.
